authorization: no. choose a solution yourself. you could use a script and a model. you could spawn a subagent.
scope: Replace unavailable external human annotations with candidate-independent automated proxy annotation and independent agent/script review. Continue original Plan 031; no continuous improvement loop.

primary.overlap: maximum mask probability; ties higher detection score then lower original detection index

review.scope: Hash/schema/geometry audits for every image, visible overlay inspection with explicit inspected-image IDs. Model-inferred boundaries and nondetections are never independently verified by audit alone.

eligibility.basketball: frozen model proxy agreement only; detected class presence and false negatives disclosed
eligibility.changing: unverified; no changing reference synthesized from M0-M2
eligibility.boundary: teacher boundary agreement only; never independently validated two-pixel accuracy
eligibility.temporal: automatic IoU>=0.5 associations with uncertain identity; no verified switches without review
eligibility.static_features: uncertain unless explicitly reviewed; automatic frozen feature retention remains descriptive

selection.segmentation: original tuple where all required proxy terms are defined on common frozen domain; otherwise explicit S2 unverified baseline default
selection.motion: M0 predeclared baseline default if independent changing/static evidence is unavailable, never labeled a measured winner

criteria_amendment.required_outcome: All 232 entries carry candidate-independent frozen model-assisted labels, per-image independent automated review/adjudication records and explicit unknown eligibility. Publish proxy metrics and available reviewed semantic/temporal strata with raw counts and uncertainties.
criteria_amendment.validation: Verify immutable original input identities/hashes, proposal, teacher checkpoint, policy and review/adjudication hashes; independent reviewer identity and explicit review scope; reject truth/human claims.
